buildable.name: Job hunt
buildable.description: Reads fifteen job boards, throws away the 98% that could never fit, screens the rest against your profile, writes a letter for the good ones and sends only what you approve. One operator gate: sending.

buildable.name: Web agency
buildable.description: Sources businesses with no website, researches them, builds a site on spec, publishes a preview and pitches the owner. Two operator gates: publishing and sending.
